summary: Established baseline architecture, identified 5 core engineering bottlenecks and product gaps.
Investigated Clay, Prithvi, SatMAE, lightweight MobileNetV4/TinyViT multi-spectral INT8 encoders, and formulated dual-memory multimodal integration for TMT Droid.
Designed non-autoregressive System-1 decision head, prototype routing, calibrated entropy gating, and tool-calling engine for Droid (< 3ms CPU latency, < 100KB head).
Researched Titans, RWKV-7 Goose, predictive coding surprise gating, Ebbinghaus forgetting, and formulated zero-pollution retrieval and sleep consolidation specs.
Investigated Dense X Retrieval, rolling anaphora resolution, AGM belief revision, SVO dual representation, and two-tier edge contradiction detection.
Researched SQLite-vec, FTS5 BM25, HNSW tradeoffs, and designed sub-3ms RRF hybrid KnowledgeStore using < 15MB RAM.
Designed zero-dependency stdio MCP server, unified headless CLI (chat/teach/decide/serve/package), dual-mode REST daemon, and portable .droid bundle format.
